svg.title: Lipoarabinomannan membrane anchor
svg.desc: Mycobacterial envelope in flat section with two lipoarabinomannan molecules: the phosphatidyl-inositol anchor sits in the plasma membrane, the mannan core crosses the periplasm and the capped, branched arabinan reaches up through peptidoglycan and arabinogalactan.
